title: Jobs
sub: Find jobs that fit your master resume — or add listings yourself — and rank them best to worst.

gate.title: Upload your resume, then find jobs that fit
gate.body: We read your resume and work out what role and location suit you. Then one tap searches job listings for the best matches. It's saved as your master resume for tailoring and interview prep too.

replaceBody: Hebrew and English resumes are saved separately — uploading a file updates the master in its own language and leaves the other untouched. Tailor, Interview, and Tools use them too.

versions.title: Resume version history
versions.body: Every time your master resume is replaced, the previous one is kept here. Restoring brings it back — and the version you're on now is kept too, so you can always come back.
versions.empty: No earlier versions yet. One is saved the first time your resume is replaced.
versions.note: The 20 most recent versions per language are kept.

skillsEditor.title: Your skills
skillsEditor.body: Add skills you actually have that your resume doesn't mention. They become part of your master resume — match scores count them and tailoring may use them.
skillsEditor.honesty: Only add skills you truly have — they will appear on your resume as facts.
skillsEditor.empty: No skills on this resume yet.
skillsEditor.placeholder: e.g. Docker, SQL — Enter or comma to add
skillsEditor.savedToast: Skills saved to your master resume.

batch.title: Tailor my top matches
batch.body: Every job at or above the fit threshold gets your resume tailored to it in the background — each one checked by the fabrication guard.
batch.none: No results at or above {{threshold}}% fit — lower the threshold.
batch.allSkipped: These jobs already have kits — see the Kits tab.

kitReview.notReady: This draft isn't tailored yet. If it stays queued, continue it from To review in the tracker.
kitReview.approvedToast: Approved — it's this job's draft in your tracker now
kitReview.approvedBanner: Approved — it's this job's draft in your tracker.
kitReview.submittedBanner: Application sent — delivered straight to the company's inbox via Comeet.
kitReview.rejectPlaceholder: Optional — e.g. wrong seniority, bad location, weak match… (helps tune the fit threshold)
kitReview.unresolvedFlags_one: {{count}} unresolved guard flag — reject the flagged edit below, or review it carefully before approving.
kitReview.unresolvedFlags_other: {{count}} unresolved guard flags — reject the flagged edits below, or review them carefully before approving.
kitReview.downloadNote: Approve, downloads, keyword counts, and the cover letter all use your accept/reject decisions below.
kitReview.coverSaveError: The letter is below, but it wasn't saved with this draft. Copy it before you leave this page.

search.cardBody: We read your resume, work out what role and location to search for, scan LinkedIn and Israeli job boards (Drushim, Comeet, JobMaster, Greenhouse), and rank every match by fit. Fully automatic — or customize the search below.
search.workModeHint: Pick one or more. We go by what each job says, and keep jobs that don't say.
search.worldwideHint: Also searches remote roles in high-paying countries on LinkedIn (the US, the UK and most of Western and Northern Europe). Jobs listed in a lower-paying country are left out, and the local Israeli boards stay local.
search.worldwideNeedsLinkedIn: Runs on LinkedIn — check the LinkedIn board below to enable it.
search.connectionDropped: The connection dropped. If the search finishes, its jobs will be in History. Searching again uses another use.
search.searchingManual: Searching job listings and scoring each one against your resume — this can take a minute or two.

stages.scoring: Scoring each job against your resume…

search.sourceErrors: Some sources were unavailable: {{sources}}. Results below come from the sources that responded.
search.sourceEmpty: Nothing matched this search on {{sources}} — results come from the other boards. Try adjusting the title or location under "Customize search".
search.hideAppliedHint: Hides jobs your tracker already marks applied, interviewing, offered or rejected. Saved jobs stay visible.

streaming.interrupted_one: Search was interrupted — showing the {{count}} job scored so far.
streaming.interrupted_other: Search was interrupted — showing the {{count}} jobs scored so far.
streaming.cancelled_one: Search cancelled — showing the {{count}} job scored so far.
streaming.cancelled_other: Search cancelled — showing the {{count}} jobs scored so far.

search.geoFiltered_one: {{count}} job states a hiring restriction abroad
search.geoFiltered_other: {{count}} jobs state a hiring restriction abroad
search.geoAllFiltered: Every job we found states a hiring restriction abroad. Read what each one says before dismissing the search.
search.filteredClosed_one: {{count}} posting is no longer accepting applications
search.filteredClosed_other: {{count}} postings are no longer accepting applications
search.filteredMarket_one: {{count}} job hidden: it's in a country where pay is well below Israel's.
search.filteredMarket_other: {{count}} jobs hidden: they're in countries where pay is well below Israel's.
search.filteredWorkMode_one: {{count}} job hidden: it says it's a work mode you didn't pick.
search.filteredWorkMode_other: {{count}} jobs hidden: they say they're a work mode you didn't pick.
search.filteredNotRemote_one: {{count}} job abroad hidden: it doesn't say it's remote.
search.filteredNotRemote_other: {{count}} jobs abroad hidden: they don't say they're remote.

card.salaryNote: Salary as stated in the posting — we never estimate.
card.kitFailed: Tailoring this kit failed — try again.
card.kitExists: This job already has a kit — see the Kits tab.
card.geoNote: Quoted from the posting — we report what it says, never whether you qualify.
card.marketNote: Hidden because pay in {{location}} is well below Israel's.
card.notRemoteNote: Hidden: it's abroad and says {{modes}}, not remote.
card.notRemoteSilent: Hidden: it's abroad and doesn't say it's remote.

ghost.evergreen: A general application, not a specific role
ghost.note: What the posting says and how long it's been up — evidence, never a verdict on whether the job is real.

card.saveDone: Saved — find it on the Tracker.
card.saveFailed: Couldn't save that job. Try again.

alerts.title: Email alerts
alerts.body: Once a day we re-run your job search and email you the new jobs that clear your fit bar.
alerts.nudgeToggle: Also remind me to follow up on quiet applications
alerts.lastRunBar: Last run {{date}} — {{count}} new jobs, {{n}} above your {{bar}}% bar
alerts.minScoreHint: Jobs below the bar still show up in your search history — they just don't reach your inbox.
alerts.customizeHint: The daily alert always runs this exact search — edit and save to change it.
alerts.autoNote: The daily search is derived automatically from your resume. Customize it to pin exact keywords, location, or boards.
alerts.unsaved: Unsaved changes — save to apply them to the daily alert.
alerts.noSmtp: Email alerts can't be sent right now. Runs still refresh your search history, but no email goes out.

manual.urlHint: We fetch the page and extract the text.
manual.noText: No readable text found at that URL.

history.emptyBody: Run a job search — every scraped job is saved here so you can apply later.
history.loadError: Could not load your search history.
